= Mysteries Guide =

Investigation system based on Cyberpunk RED Interface Volume 5 ("Did Someone Say Murder?"). Players use a Focus pool to run Evidence Checks on clues, reducing a mystery's complexity until it is solved.

----

== Overview ==

'''Mysteries''' are investigations with a goal and a complexity value. '''Clues''' are attached to rooms, NPCs, or objects. Players make '''Evidence Checks''' (skill rolls) to decipher clues; success reduces the mystery's complexity; failure costs Focus. When complexity reaches 0, the mystery is solved.

'''Key concepts:'''
* '''Focus''' – Pool based on INT + WILL; depletes on failed checks; recovers every 24 hours (half max)
* '''Evidence Check''' – Stat + Skill + 1d10 vs clue DV; success = damage to complexity; failure = lose Focus
* '''Clue order''' – Some clues require others to be deciphered first

----

== Player Guide ==

=== Requirements ===

* Character must be '''approved''' by staff
* Focus &gt; 0 to make Evidence Checks

=== Viewing Focus ===

<pre>
+mystery              - Your Focus and active mysteries
+mystery/focus        - Detailed Focus info
</pre>

Focus recovers every 24 hours (half your max). If Focus is 0, you cannot make Evidence Checks until it recovers.

=== Investigating ===

<pre>
+investigate &lt;target&gt;     - Investigate a room, NPC, or object
+investigate &lt;clue id&gt;     - Investigate a clue by ID (abstract clues)
+investigate/hint          - DV15 Deduction for a hint (costs 1d6 Focus)
</pre>

'''Targets:'''
* <code>here</code>, <code>room</code>, <code>location</code> – Current room
* NPC or object name – Something in the room
* Clue ID – Direct clue reference (e.g. <code>+investigate 5</code>)

'''Flow:'''
# Find a location with a clue (staff attach clues via <code>+addclue</code>)
# Run <code>+investigate here</code> (or the NPC/object name)
# Success: Clue damage reduces mystery complexity; you see remaining complexity
# Failure: Lose Focus (1d6 or 2d6 depending on clue type)
# If required clues exist, you must decipher them first

'''Hint:''' <code>+investigate/hint</code> – Roll DV15 Deduction; success = GM provides a nudge; always costs 1d6 Focus.

=== Clue Attempt Limits ===

One attempt per clue per character per day. If you fail, you can try again tomorrow.

----

== Staff Guide ==

=== Creating a Mystery ===

<pre>
+createmystery &lt;name&gt;=&lt;goal&gt;,&lt;complexity&gt;
</pre>

'''Example:''' <code>+createmystery "Warehouse Murder"=Find who killed the guard,50</code>

* '''Complexity''' – Typically 50 or 100; when reduced to 0, mystery is solved
* '''Goal''' – Short description of what solving means

=== Creating Clues ===

<pre>
+createclue &lt;mystery id&gt;=&lt;type&gt;,&lt;skills&gt;,&lt;dv&gt;,&lt;obfuscation&gt;
</pre>

'''Example:''' <code>+createclue 1=forensics,criminology;deduction,13,2</code>

* '''type''' – forensics, deduction, etc. (affects damage dice)
* '''skills''' – Semicolon-separated (e.g. criminology;deduction)
* '''dv''' – Difficulty value for the Evidence Check (e.g. 13)
* '''obfuscation''' – Reduces damage dealt on success (e.g. 2)

=== Placing Clues ===

<pre>
+addclue &lt;target&gt;=&lt;clue id&gt;           - Attach clue to room/NPC/object
+addclue/remove &lt;target&gt;=&lt;clue id&gt;    - Remove clue from target
+addclue/list &lt;target&gt;                 - List clues on target
</pre>

'''Target:''' Room name, NPC name, or object name. You must be in the room or able to search it.

=== Clue Order (Required Clues) ===

<pre>
+linkclue/requires &lt;clue&gt;=&lt;clue id&gt;   - Clue requires another to be deciphered first
+linkclue &lt;clue&gt;=&lt;clue id&gt;             - Link clues (for reference)
</pre>

Players must decipher the required clue before they can attempt the dependent clue.

=== Linking to Missions ===

<pre>
+mysterylink &lt;mystery id&gt;=&lt;mission id&gt;   - Link mystery to mission
+mysterylink/unlink &lt;mystery id&gt;         - Unlink from mission
</pre>

When a mystery is solved, linked missions and jobs are updated automatically.

=== Listing and Deleting ===

<pre>
+clues                    - List all clues
+clues &lt;mystery&gt;         - List clues for one mystery
+destroyclue &lt;clue id&gt;   - Delete clue from system (removes from all locations)
+destroyclue &lt;target&gt;=&lt;clue id&gt;  - Remove clue from target only
</pre>

----

== Workflow Summary ==

'''Staff:'''
# <code>+createmystery "Name"="Goal",complexity</code>
# <code>+createclue &lt;mystery id&gt;=type,skills,dv,obfuscation</code> for each clue
# <code>+addclue &lt;room/NPC/object&gt;=&lt;clue id&gt;</code> to place clues
# <code>+linkclue/requires &lt;clue&gt;=&lt;required clue id&gt;</code> for clue order
# <code>+mysterylink &lt;mystery id&gt;=&lt;mission id&gt;</code> if tied to a mission

'''Player:'''
# <code>+mystery</code> to check Focus
# <code>+investigate here</code> (or room/NPC/object/clue ID) to run Evidence Check
# Success: complexity decreases; at 0, mystery solved
# Failure: lose Focus; try again tomorrow
